Ole Miss vs. Vanderbilt betting odds
Ole Miss vs. Vanderbilt betting preview

Ole Miss is coming off a bye week after being handed its first loss, a 52-28 blowout at Florida, in Week 4. Quarterback Trinidad Chambliss threw for 298 yards, one touchdown and one interception on 25 of 34 passing, while also recording a team-best 44 yards and two touchdowns on seven rushing attempts in the loss.

Vanderbilt is coming off back-to-back losses to Auburn, 21-15, and Georgia, 38-14, ahead of Week 6. The Commodores faced a 21-14 deficit at halftime against Georgia before allowing 17 unanswered points in the second half. Ole Miss vs. Vanderbilt picks, prediction

Vanderbilt is 3-2 in its last five games against-the-spread, having covered in each of its last three games, including its first two SEC games of the season. The Commodores have a 2-0 ATS record as the underdog and 1-0 ATS against ranked opponents, but are 1-2 as the home team. Running back Sedrick Alexander leads Vanderbilt with 200 yards and four touchdowns on 45 rushing attempts, which includes 35 yards and one touchdown on eight attempts last Saturday.

Ole Miss is 1-3 against-the-spread, with its one cover coming in its Week 3 win against LSU, having closed as a 3-point underdog at home. The Rebels have a 0-1 ATS record as an away team and a 0-2 ATS record as the favorite in 2026. Chambliss is leading the SEC with 305.5 passing yards per game, having thrown for 1,222 yards, eight touchdowns and three interceptions on 102 of 144 passing, while also recording 108 yards and four touchdowns on 28 rushing attempts.
